The '''2019–20 Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team''' represented [[Duke University]] during the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were coached by 40th-year head coach, [[Mike Krzyzewski]]. The Blue Devils played their home games at [[Cameron Indoor Stadium]] in [[Durham, North Carolina]], as a member of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]].

The Blue Devils finished the season 25–6, and 15–5 in [[2019–20 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]].  The team was scheduled to play [[2019–20 NC State Wolfpack men's basketball team|NC State]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2020 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] before the tournament was cancelled due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]].<ref name="ACC Tournament">{{cite web |title=Statement from ACC on Men's Basketball Tournament |url=https://theacc.com/news/2020/3/12/statement-from-acc-on-mens-basketball-tournament.aspx |website=theacc.com |publisher=Atlantic Coast Conference |access-date=12 March 2020}}</ref>  The [[2020 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] was also cancelled due to the pandemic.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ncaa.org/about/resources/media-center/news/ncaa-cancels-remaining-winter-and-spring-championships|title=NCAA cancels remaining winter and spring championships}}</ref>

==Previous season==
The [[2018–19 Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team|Blue Devils]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 32–6, 14–4 in [[2018–19 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in second place. They won the [[2019 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC Tournament title]], the school's 21st tournament championship.<ref>{{Cite news|url= http://www.goduke.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=4200&ATCLID=211795899|title=Duke Beats FSU for Program's 21st ACC Title|work=www.goduke.com|access-date=March 16, 2019}}</ref> As a result, they received the conference's automatic bid to the [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the overall No. 1 seed in the East region. There they defeated [[2018–19 North Dakota State Bison men's basketball team|North Dakota State]], [[2018–19 UCF Knights men's basketball team|UCF]], and [[2018–19 Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball team|Virginia Tech]] to advance to the Elite Eight where they lost to No. 2 seed [[2018–19 Michigan State Spartans men's basketball team|Michigan State]].
